explain.en: Every package pnpm has installed, kept once and hard-linked into each project's node_modules. Deleting it by hand frees little while projects still link to it, so Hoardless only shows pnpm's own command, which removes packages no project uses any more.
explain.zh: pnpm 装过的所有包，只存一份，再用硬链接放进各个项目的 node_modules。项目还连着它的时候手动删也腾不出多少空间，所以这里只给出 pnpm 自带的命令，它会删掉已经没有项目在用的包。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac: 14G in v10 (11G), v11 (1.3G) and v3 (2.0G); `pnpm store path` (pnpm 10.20.0) prints ~/Library/pnpm/store/v10. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: Files are hard-linked into node_modules, so du overstates what a prune frees. `pnpm store prune` only works on the store version of the pnpm that runs it; older version folders (e.g. v3) stay until removed some other way.
